title: Pay the construction industry training levy
what: As the owner of a construction project, pay the training levy before a building or plumbing permit is issued.

laws.title: Building and Construction Industry Training Fund Act 1990 (Tas)

sources.title: Building and Construction Industry Training Fund Act 1990 (Tas)
sources.quote: The project owner in respect of any building or construction work is liable to pay the levy on that building or construction work before the issue of a building permit or plumbing permit in respect of that work

sources.title: Building and Construction Industry Training Fund Act 1990 (Tas)
sources.quote: A project owner shall pay the levy to the Board or a collection agency
